lines_of_business: MedStar Family Choice District of Columbia (Medicaid MCO)
sections_in_order: B. Indications for Pneumatic Compression Devices (1-7)
criteria_location: Section B, pp.2-5, numbered 1-7 with a-h letters and i-vi sub-items; stage definitions in a footnote on p.5.

logic.top_level: all (B.1 all of a-h), B.2 programmable: all of a-e on top of B.1

k_of_n.quote: documented presence of at least one of the following findings: Marked hyperkeratosis with hyperplasia and hyperpigmentation; Papillomatosis cutis lymphostatica; Deformity of elephantiasis; Skin breakdown with persisting lymphorrhea

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: B.3-B.7 list non-covered uses: other clinical situations, other diseases, head and neck, non-extremity, truncal-only lymphedema.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Reassessment loop: 'If there has been improvement, then a pneumatic compression device will not be approved ... trial of conservative therapy must be continued with subsequent reassessment at four-week intervals.' No continued-use criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The Enrollee must have documented persistence over a period of at least six months of "chronic and severe" lymphedema as identified by ... at least one of the following findings
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Six-month duration plus a stage that excludes Stage 0/1 and mild lymphedema; relation between 'severe findings' and 'Stage' unclear.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: iv. Documentation of ability of member/caregiver to apply the device in frequency prescribed. v. Documentation of ability of member/caregiver to apply the device in frequency prescribed.
f. ... ii. The Enrollee has other complications such as severe fibrosis, recurrent cellulitis or skin breakdown.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Under 'documentation for no improvement must include all of the following' - requires complications as a condition of failure, not just no improvement.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: d. The Enrollee must have extremity lymphedema extending onto the chest, trunk and/or abdomen ... and the chest, trunk and/or abdominal lymphedema has failed to improve with four-week trial defined above and is not covered without lymphedema extending onto chest, trunk, abdomen.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Run-on sentence; E0652 requires BOTH unique characteristics (c) and truncal extension (d) as written - 'all of the following'.

requirement_kinds.quote: A documented diagnosis of lymphedema as well as the cause of the lymphedema ... and the date of onset of swelling.
documented persistence over a period of at least six months of "chronic and severe" lymphedema
Marked hyperkeratosis with hyperplasia and hyperpigmentation; Papillomatosis cutis lymphostatica; Deformity of elephantiasis; Skin breakdown with persisting lymphorrhea
The Enrollee must be under the care of a lymphedema specialist or program.
Circumferential measurement charts demonstrating significant asymmetrical swelling
Stage 0/Stage 1 and/or mild lymphedema do not meet criteria for a pneumatic compression device

compliant with a minimum of a four-week trial of conservative therapy ... compression bandage or garment ... minimum of 30mmHg distally; Exercise; Elevation; Manual lymphatic drainage with a lymphedema specialist; Self-manual lymphatic drainage for a least 30 minutes per day; Counseling on weight reduction
Detailed measurements obtained in the same manner and with reference to the same anatomic landmarks, prior to and at the conclusion of the various trials and therapy
the prescribing provider must sign and date these reports and state agreement or disagreement ... The signature date must be on or before the pneumatic compression device prescription date.
failed a minimum of four weeks of regular, daily, multiple-hour home usage of a non-programmable pump (E0650 or E0651) after careful in-person fitting, training and supervision
must have extremity lymphedema extending onto the chest, trunk and/or abdomen
Documents must justify why the Enrollee has a medical need for a programmable pneumatic compression device and how that will produce better results

thresholds.quote: for a least 30 minutes per day

time_windows.quote: minimum of four weeks of regular, daily, multiple-hour home usage

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Only E0650, E0651, E0652 mentioned inline; no code tables.

external_dependencies.what: Companion policy for venous stasis ulcers
external_dependencies.quote: lymphedema or chronic venous insufficiency with venous stasis ulcers (see policy #1420)
[Clinical Stage as defined by The International Society of Lymphology]
in accordance with the MedStar Family Choice Prior Authorization Policy

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Stage II - Lymphedema does not resolve with limb elevation alone.
sufficient pressure at the lowest pressure point to cause fluid movement
possible to make manual adjustments in the pressure on at least three outflow ports

vague_terms.quote: Clinician determination from a provider experienced in lymphedema treatment

vague_terms.problem: Defined only by the skin findings.

extraction_hazards: Footnote asterisk glyph '⃰' attaches the stage table to criterion ii.
Page footer 'Proprietary & Confidential n' interrupts lists.
Summary of Changes table at the end holds a rule (caregiver ability) added in 07/22.
interesting_structures: Most prescriptive of the four: severity findings, specialist, 6-month persistence, 4-week trial with six components, same-landmark measurement, signature-timing rule.
Improvement during the trial blocks approval and restarts the trial (loop).
Truncal extension required for programmable pump.

fit_to_tree.why: Pure all-of list with nested lists and numbers, but many sub-criteria require reading provider notes (specialist, signature dates, measurement landmarks), a looping trial, and duplicated/contradictory items.
